entities.name: Rosheen Meanderer
entities.description: Ancient giant shaman of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor known for babbling and accurate prophecies, unaffected by the Great Aurora.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: Celestial convergence every 300 years that transforms the plane between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Brion Stoutarm
entities.description: Giant, Rosheen's brother, killed by Gilt-Leaf forces.

entities.name: Kiel
entities.description: Giant, Rosheen's sister or sibling who collects stories.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Gilt-Leaf daen who delivered the scroll and ordered the dream to end.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Mysterious elf who devised the plan to enter Rosheen's sleep.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Vied for control of the plane and desired Rosheen's scroll.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: Site of the Festival of Tales.

events.summary: Brion and Kiel gather stories for Rosheen's birthday and give Rhys a scroll to deliver.
events.quote: entrusting him with a scroll of accumulated stories to deliver to Rosheen

events.summary: Rhys, Maralen and her faeries find Rosheen asleep, surrounded by dancing changelings.
events.quote: eventually came upon Rosheen, who was in a deep sleep

events.summary: Maralen's plan pulls them into Rosheen's sleep, producing a shared dreamscape.
events.quote: Maralen devised a plan to pull them all into Rosheen’s sleep

events.summary: The dream map shows the plane sliding into darkness; Rhys ends the dream and Brion is killed by Gilt-Leaf forces.
events.quote: Shortly after, Brion was killed by Gilt-Leaf forces.

events.summary: Rosheen awakes after the Great Aurora has turned Lorwyn into Shadowmoor and searches for Mr. Choppers.
events.quote: Lorwyn had become Shadowmoor through the influence of the Great Aurora

events.summary: Mistmeadow Jack, helped by Maralen, reroutes Rosheen away from Mistmeadow in exchange for her scroll.
events.quote: Rosheen's path was rerouted by Mistmeadow Jack

relations.quote: Rosheen was the sister of Brion Stoutarm and Kiel
